name: agent_wakes_on_a_row
title: Agents · an agent wakes when a row is added, once, and never on its own writes

steps.say: make a table named deals with each deal's name, its EBITDA in millions and its stage
steps.reply:
I've made a **Deals** table in a new **Deal pipeline** section. It has three columns:

- **Name**: the deal's name (required)
- **EBITDA**: a number in millions, marked $M
- **Stage**: one of Sourcing, Screening, Due diligence, LOI, Closing, Closed or Passed

You didn't list the stages, so I used common deal-pipeline ones. I can rename them or switch the currency if your process is different.

The table is empty for now. Give me your deals and I'll add them.

steps.say: add a deal: Midwest HVAC, EBITDA 2.1, stage new
steps.reply: I added Midwest HVAC to your deals with EBITDA of $2.1M. Your stages don't include "New," so I put it in **Sourcing**, which is the first one. If you'd rather have "New" as its own stage, I can add it.

checks.why: 1 run(s) woken by events; Run of Deal Analyst, woken by: 1 row(s) added to Deals: Midwest HVAC; last: I screened Midwest HVAC and added the row "Screened: Midwest HVAC" to the deals list. Its stage is set to "Screening" because the list has no "screened" stage a
